name: dev-skills
description: Governed workflows for agentic docs, agent orchestration, test coverage, preprod testing, guided and autonomous manual acceptance tests with a review fix-loop, safe merges, legal texts and new projects

agents_md_doc_language.title: Documentation language
agents_md_doc_language.description: Language code of generated agent documentation (English by default: the audience is a model).

agents_md_tier_policy.title: Tier policy
agents_md_tier_policy.description: Size tier for init: auto picks from the measured repository, or force 1, 2 or 3.

agents_md_install_guardrail_scripts.title: Install guardrail scripts
agents_md_install_guardrail_scripts.description: Copy the check_*.py guardrail scripts into the target project by default (opt-out).

agents_md_guardrail_scripts_path.title: Guardrail scripts path
agents_md_guardrail_scripts_path.description: Project-relative folder where the check_*.py guardrail scripts are copied.

agents_md_commit_convention_policy.title: Commit convention policy
agents_md_commit_convention_policy.description: detect: document the convention found in history; enforce: require conventional commits; skip: document none.

agents_md_archives_policy.title: Archives policy
agents_md_archives_policy.description: Dead references inside dated records (errors/, adr/, postmortems/): tolerate (report one P3 info finding), annotate (sync rewrites only the reference as new (formerly old)), fix (sync replaces the reference).

full_test_redeploy.title: Redeploy strategy
full_test_redeploy.description: Default redeploy policy: dispatch the deploy workflow when possible (else empty commit), skip when preprod already serves HEAD.

full_test_reseed.title: Reseed policy
full_test_reseed.description: Reseed the preprod database only when the target is proven preprod and the suite does not reseed itself.

full_test_suites.title: Suite selection
full_test_suites.description: Which suites run without a menu. Costly suites always need their own confirmation.

full_test_confirm_profile.title: Confirm detected profile
full_test_confirm_profile.description: Wait for confirmation after the Phase 0 announce of the detected profile.

full_test_commit_pending.title: Commit pending work
full_test_commit_pending.description: Commit and push uncommitted work before redeploying in a non-fix-loop run.

legal_editor_name.title: Editor legal name
legal_editor_name.description: Default legal name for mentions légales when config and published pages lack it

legal_editor_form.title: Editor legal form
legal_editor_form.description: Default legal form (e.g. association-1901, sasu, sas, ei)

legal_tone.title: Document tone
legal_tone.description: Drafting tone for generated legal texts

legal_en_bref.title: En bref summaries
legal_en_bref.description: Add a short summary box at the head of each article

legal_risk_appetite.title: Accepted-risk appetite
legal_risk_appetite.description: Whether measured risks may be proposed for the accepted_risks register

legal_mediator_default.title: Médiateur default
legal_mediator_default.description: Default when no consumer-mediation agreement is known

legal_report_language.title: Report language
legal_report_language.description: Language of findings and reports: auto (the user's conversation language, fallback en) or a code such as en or fr. Published legal texts follow the project audience language (French for French law).

new_project_ui_language.title: UI language
new_project_ui_language.description: Language of questions and reports shown to the user (code and commits stay English).

new_project_docs_language.title: Docs language
new_project_docs_language.description: Language of README and human-facing project docs.

new_project_look_and_feel.title: Look and feel baseline
new_project_look_and_feel.description: Visual baseline used when the user gives no reference apps.

new_project_privacy_default.title: Privacy default
new_project_privacy_default.description: Vhost protection when data is private and the app has no auth of its own.

new_project_auto_name.title: Auto-name
new_project_auto_name.description: Use the recommended project name without waiting for a choice at the checkpoint.

new_project_host_domain_pattern.title: Host domain pattern
new_project_host_domain_pattern.description: Base domain for <project>.<base>; <dashed-ip>.nip.io or a real wildcard domain.

new_project_port_range_start.title: Port range start
new_project_port_range_start.description: First loopback port reserved for deployments.

new_project_port_range_end.title: Port range end
new_project_port_range_end.description: Last loopback port reserved for deployments.

new_project_deploy_host.title: Deploy host
new_project_deploy_host.description: Where the app is hosted; only the local VPS is implemented.

new_project_hosting_enabled.title: Hosting enabled
new_project_hosting_enabled.description: false makes every run behave as --no-host by default.

new_project_min_disk_gb.title: Free-disk floor (GB)
new_project_min_disk_gb.description: Minimum free disk checked by the host-safety script (NP_MIN_DISK_GB).

new_project_agents_fallback.title: Agents fallback
new_project_agents_fallback.description: What to do when dedicated agent types are missing.

orchestration_agents_location.title: Agent types location
orchestration_agents_location.description: Where subagent type files live: global (~/.claude/agents/, shared by all projects) or project (.claude/agents/, versioned).

orchestration_cost_posture.title: Cost posture
orchestration_cost_posture.description: Model choice policy: cheapest adequate rung, balanced, or capability-first.

orchestration_matrix.title: Agent type matrix
orchestration_matrix.description: Number of subagent types: five (quick/standard per tier plus top deep), three, or none (model parameter only).

orchestration_deep_gate.title: Deep type gate
orchestration_deep_gate.description: When the top deep type may run.

orchestration_builtin_overrides.title: Built-in overrides
orchestration_builtin_overrides.description: Built-ins to override, comma-separated: explore (Explore agent on the low model), subagent-model-env (CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL in settings.json). Use none to skip.

orchestration_delegation_rationale.title: Context-economy rationale
orchestration_delegation_rationale.description: Include the one-sentence context-economy rationale in the delegation rule.

orchestration_delegation_fallback.title: Delegation fallback
orchestration_delegation_fallback.description: What to do when delegation is unavailable.

orchestration_report_style.title: Subagent report style
orchestration_report_style.description: Style imposed on subagent reports; in-agents-md-section leaves reporting to the agents-md behaviour section.

orchestration_shared_tree_bans.title: Shared-tree bans
orchestration_shared_tree_bans.description: Comma-separated commands banned on a shared working tree.

orchestration_cite_incident.title: Cite field incident
orchestration_cite_incident.description: Cite the stash/orphan-migration incident as one clause in the parallelism rule.

orchestration_ask_before_dispatch.title: Ask before dispatch
orchestration_ask_before_dispatch.description: Whether the orchestrator asks questions freely before decomposing, or biases to action.

orchestration_session_naming.title: Session naming
orchestration_session_naming.description: Dispatched session label variant: auto (badge if a statusline script exists, prefix otherwise), badge-with-fallback, or prefix.

orchestration_check_script_path.title: Check script path
orchestration_check_script_path.description: Where check_agent_refs.py is copied: auto (.claude/orchestration/, or scripts/ when git already tracks scripts/check_* files) or a path.

orchestration_report_language.title: Report language
orchestration_report_language.description: Language of reports to the user: auto (the user's conversation language, fallback en) or a code such as en or fr. Written documents follow the base doc language.

safe_merge_backups_auto_run.title: Auto-run backups
safe_merge_backups_auto_run.description: Run fully covered native backups without further asking; false builds a backup plan and executes it only once validated.

safe_merge_offpeak_preference.title: Off-peak preference
safe_merge_offpeak_preference.description: recommend: advise an off-peak window; require: in-flight prod jobs or peak hours are a no-go unless overridden at the gate; ignore: skip the advice.

safe_merge_changelog_review.title: Review CHANGELOG entry
safe_merge_changelog_review.description: Show the CHANGELOG draft inside the Phase 6 recap for human edits; false commits it as drafted after the go.

safe_merge_surveillance_minutes.title: Post-merge surveillance minutes
safe_merge_surveillance_minutes.description: Length of the post-deploy surveillance window.

safe_merge_smoke_depth.title: Smoke-test depth
safe_merge_smoke_depth.description: basic: health and version only; standard: plus login, media and queue checks; deep: plus authenticated client flows when the diff touches build args or media.

test_coverage_default_scope.title: Default scope
test_coverage_default_scope.description: Which part of the inventory a run targets when no --domains is given: every domain, or only domains that drifted since the last audit.

test_coverage_dynamic_pass.title: Dynamic exploration pass
test_coverage_dynamic_pass.description: Run the dynamic (running-app) exploration pass during audit when the app is launchable. Off turns it into a declared blind spot.

test_coverage_speed_target_minutes.title: Speed target (minutes)
test_coverage_speed_target_minutes.description: Suite wall-clock target for speed mode when the project config sets no speed.target_minutes.

test_coverage_report_language.title: Report language
test_coverage_report_language.description: Language of generated reports and findings: auto (the user's conversation language, fallback en) or a code such as en or fr (all files and identifiers stay English).

manual_test_language.title: Report language
manual_test_language.description: Language of chat and reports: auto (the user's conversation language, fallback en) or a code such as en or fr (all files and identifiers stay English).

manual_test_mode.title: Test mode
manual_test_mode.description: Who tests: guided (a human, one step at a time) or autonomous (the agent runs the steps in a browser and delivers a screenshot report).

manual_test_fix_loop_aspects.title: Fix-loop aspects
manual_test_fix_loop_aspects.description: Aspects preselected in the fix-loop launch interview besides obvious problems (always fixed): evident (none), minor, ideas, or minor,ideas.

manual_test_fix_loop_simplification.title: Fix-loop simplification
manual_test_fix_loop_simplification.description: Preselected simplification answer: no, propose (each one approved first) or auto (guard-safe ones applied, others proposed). Never touches legal, payment, consent or safety steps.

manual_test_fix_loop_max_iterations.title: Fix-loop iteration cap
manual_test_fix_loop_max_iterations.description: Preselected iteration cap of the fix-loop.

manual_test_archive_folder.title: Archive folder
manual_test_archive_folder.description: Project folder receiving the archived notes: auto detects DOCS/AUDIT/, docs/audit/ or docs/ (else asks), or a project-relative path.
